title: log1p
description: Logarithmize the data matrix. Computes X = log(X + 1), where log denotes the natural logarithm unless a different base is given.

input.help_text: type: `string`, multiple: False, required, direction: `input`, example: `input.h5mu`

modality.description: Which modality from the input MuData file to process.

input_layer.description: Input layer to use. If None, X is normalized

output_layer.description: Output layer to use. By default, use X.

output.help_text: type: `string`, multiple: False, required, default: `output.h5mu`, direction: `output`

base.description: Base of the logarithm. Natural logarithm is used by default.

output_compression.description:
Compression format to use for the output AnnData and/or Mudata H5 files.
By default no compression is applied.

nextflow input-output arguments.title: Nextflow input-output arguments
nextflow input-output arguments.description: Input/output parameters for Nextflow itself. Please note that both publishDir and publish_dir are supported but at least one has to be configured.
